name: broad-news
description: RATBAC-gated news aggregation, weighted source scoring, and script/blurb generation for BroadBanner creators. Aggregates stories by keyword from RSS (primary), web search, and scraping fallbacks. Self-managing source scores in D1 via the BroadBanner gateway. Generates 30-90 sec video scripts and platform-specific social blurbs. Integrates with BannerBlast for review/edit/approve workflows and article draft generation.
